snippet.title: Cosmic Cat Steam Release Day!!
snippet.description:
Cosmic Cat launches on Steam today in under 2 hours! (3pm GMT). I haven’t posted much as I’ve spent the last 6 weeks focusing on improving & playtesting.  Hope you get to enjoy and have fun!

Available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873550/Cosmic_Cat/
#NewRelease #catgame #indiegame #gamedev #steam
